reviews.text: Oh we absolutely love our haircuts with Christina!! She's the sweetest, so gentle and loving to Olive and does an amazing job with the cuts!! Olive loves being back :)
Amazing service and lovely people! The van is really convenient and I love that I am able to watch my dog while he is being groomed, he always gets anxious about washing but this keeps him calm.
My poms looked beautiful!! Is not easy to do a teddy tidy up (not hair cut taking it to short hair) for poms. Leaving some pictures. Groomerang is great!!

Absolutely amazing service! The mobile groomer arrived right on time and was so gentle and professional with my dog. My pup has never looked better – hands down the best cut he’s ever had! Super convenient, stress-free, and top-quality grooming. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a reliable and talented dog groomer.
A lovely person and a lovely business, really glad that she does what she does.

Couldn’t ask for a lovelier and more professional service. Cristina took such good care of our puppy’s first groom, ensuring she was happy and comfortable throughout. No trauma here - and I would suggest that for any dog that has had a bad experience, you try this service instead! Thanks for making our little one ready for the winter weather.
